Glucose will still go to Health Connect, where other apps can see it. Install Samsung Health to see the charts there.

The data is older than 10 minutes, check LibreLink. Glucose alarms come only from there.

An estimate from the average sensor glucose, not a blood test: a lab HbA1c may differ. Reliable with at least %1$d%% of the data over 14 days. Samsung Health takes HbA1c only as a manual entry, Health Connect does not carry it.
In the background every %1$s, without a notification

Fresh glucose in Samsung Health every minute
LibreLinkUp keeps only 12 hours. The full history lives in LibreView: download it and choose which days to send to Samsung Health.

Tick the days you want in Samsung Health

All SugarBridge glucose records for the selected days (%1$d) will disappear from Health Connect and Samsung Health, both those from LibreView and those from LibreLinkUp. Your data in LibreView stays untouched.
Samsung Health takes glucose from Health Connect by itself. No points? In Samsung Health → Settings → Health Connect, check that it may read “Blood glucose”.

Android allows no more than every 15 minutes without a notification. With the minute mode on, it can stay on as a backup. Each run fetches the last 12 hours, so nothing is missed even if the phone slept.
Glucose reaches Samsung Health a minute or two after the sensor reads it. A notification stays in the shade while it runs.
A number in the status bar and in the notification shade. Turn it off to make the notification quiet and move it to the bottom of the shade
The interval doesn’t stretch while the screen is off, but the battery drains faster
Android lets an app work this often only while it shows a notification. If it bothers you, turn it off with the button above; the mode keeps working.
Glucose within this range counts as normal: it is shown green, below it pink, above it orange. The chart band and the “in range” share use it too. LibreLink alarms don’t change.
Not a medical device: glucose alarms and treatment decisions belong to LibreLink only. LibreLinkUp and LibreView are used through an unofficial API, with your own account and data only.
SugarBridge sends glucose to Samsung Health through Health Connect. Without it the data has nowhere to go.
